faults.quote: Use it with the preposition 'ب' (بـ) when you mean 'to understand something'
faults.why: False grammar: فَهِمَ takes a direct object (or عَنْ/مِنْ for a person), not بِـ.

faults.quote: To perceive the meaning of words ... To know the meaning or interpretation
faults.why: Both senses are identical; example 1 literally uses مَعْنَى ('meaning') for 'know the meaning'.

faults.quote: This verb is used for both general comprehension and knowing the specific meaning
faults.why: Pure filler justifying the artificial sense split.
